text:
maria: Heads-up — saw a ~3x token cost spike for tenant `monoapp-prod` around 02:00 UTC. Per-route panel shows cache savings flipping negative for that tenant :eyes:. Anyone else seeing this?

josh: Looking now. Dashboard link: https://console/redwood/econ/route?tenant=monoapp-prod :chart_with_upwards_trend:

kevin: Can you paste the sparkline for the last 6h? suspicious this might be a sampling anomaly in the hourly rollup.

maria: Sparkline attached (copied values): `[0.12,0.10,0.11,0.09,0.32,0.35]` — jumps at 02:00. Cache credit column shows -$0.02/token for that window.

sophia: Weird. We shipped the deferred amortization window change in the rollout last night (canary=10% then ramp). Could be the amortization boundary moved and credits got applied to the wrong hour. @max fyi.

max: Ops-bot shows a canary rollout step at 01:45: `deferred_amort_window=60->360` on service `econ-aggregator`. Deploy log:```
ops-bot: deploy econ-aggregator v3.12.1 canary 01:45
maria: noted
```

josh: If the amort window increased from 60->360s we might be delaying when prefetch/cache credits are applied (so hour boundaries look negative). That fits the sudden negative saving.

kevin: Query I ran to validate lineage (truncated):```
SELECT hour, tenant, sum(token_cost) as cost, sum(cache_credit) as credit
FROM econ.hourly_rollup
WHERE tenant = 'monoapp-prod' AND hour >= '2026-03-20T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY hour, tenant
ORDER BY hour;
```

sophia: Nice. Can you also check per-invocation path for that hour to see if credits landed on a different tenant/session due to sessionized shard change?

kevin: Quick grep shows lots of invocations attributed to `tenant:monoapp-prod` but credit.trace_id appears to be null for many rows between 01:50-02:10. Looks like amortization write path failed to write lineage for a short window.

maria: Oof. So UI shows negative because cost hits without crediting. Two follow-ups: 1) roll back the config on canary if still running, 2) add an alert for negative net savings > threshold for any tenant-hour.

max: Canary finished ramp at 02:10 per ops-bot. Rolling back now to previous amort window and opening a rollback PR. Will post PR link.

ops-bot: rollback econ-aggregator v3.12.1 -> v3.12.0 initiated by max at 02:12 UTC.

josh: For dashboard UX: we should show a tooltip explaining 'deferred amortization window' and a small warning badge when hours are incomplete. Users kept pinging product saying "why did my savings go negative" — need better context.

kevin: Agreed. Also propose a console-side synthetic: mark hours as "tentative" until lineage write is confirmed for >95% of invocations. That will avoid alarming customers for transient attribution gaps.

sophia: For telemetry: emit an event `amort_window_change` with old/new and rollout id so we can join changes to econ anomalies automatically.

maria: Action list: max will finish rollback + PR, kevin will run a backfill to re-apply credits for affected hours, josh + design to add tooltip + tentative badge, sophia to add telemetry event in next patch. I'll DM infra to prioritize backfill.

max: PR: https://github.com/redwood/econ/pull/789 — rollback + revert config. Backfill scheduled in 30m.

kevin: Backfill job started: `backfill_credits --tenant monoapp-prod --from 2026-03-20T01:00Z --to 2026-03-20T03:00Z` — will post progress.

maria: Thanks all. Let's also add an alerting rule (pager if negative net > $50 in an hour) and a low-severity slack ping at >$5 so we can catch before customers notice.

josh: I'll sketch the alert and UX copy. Quick note: avoid calling it "negative cache savings" in user-facing text — say "unapplied cache credits" or similar.

sophia: Will add telemetry event + link to rollout id in traces so root-cause is easier next time.

ops-bot: backfill job 98765 progress: 30% completed, ETA 18m.

maria: Closing loop — will follow up in morning with postmortem notes and cost delta. Thanks :thumbsup:
